description: This file defines a React hook `useTypeaheadAllowingSpacesAndPunctuation` that implements a custom typeahead trigger matching logic allowing spaces and punctuation, based on a specified trigger string. It references external libraries such as 'lexical' for text editing and 'react' for React hooks.

methods.name: useTypeaheadAllowingSpacesAndPunctuation
methods.description: A React hook that returns a trigger function for matching a pattern in the text, allowing spaces and punctuation after a specified trigger string. It constructs a regex based on parameters and uses `useCallback` for memoization.
